purpose: Trigger-accuracy eval for the TravelSync project skills. Checks that each skill fires on the messages it should and stays quiet on near-misses that share its vocabulary. Re-run after editing any skill description.
method: Three independent judges are given only the skill names + descriptions (as Claude Code sees them) plus these messages in varying order, and asked which skill(s) they would consult. Unanimity across judges indicates the description is unambiguous.
last_result: 45/45 unanimous; 7/7 correct triggers, 8/8 correct declines, 0 false positives, 0 false negatives
